description: The OIDC identity login (https://docs.doppler.com/docs/service-account-identities) always returns the short-lived token and its expiry; the token is a credential and must be delivered redacted. The request's `token` is the OIDC token issued by the caller's provider, the credential the login exchanges, so it is sensitive too. (The endpoint is public — the OIDC token is the credential — which scripts/generate.ts enforces through PUBLIC_OPERATIONS; the converter does not read operation-level `security`.)
